as_told.title: Alex Jones' CNN call warning Osama bin Laden about the Twin Towers

plain: Before the attacks of 2001, the radio host Alex Jones is said to have warned on air that if a terrorist group hit the World Trade Center, everyone would know who to blame. Michels tells it himself in two talks about dreams and seeing the future, offering it as a possible case of premonition. In the second he puts the remark on CNN and has Jones addressing Osama bin Laden directly: take down the Twin Towers and I will come after you.
